preconditions.description: The number of students in the class is between 2 and 105, inclusive.
Each student's best friend is a valid student number within the class.
A student is not their own best friend.
Each student's sex is either 1 (boy) or 2 (girl).

postconditions.description: The maximum number of pairs formed is non-negative.
The maximum number of boy-girl pairs is non-negative.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= ai, bi <= n for ai, bi in pairs)
postconditions.description: Each pair consists of valid student numbers.

postconditions.expression: each student is included in at most one pair
postconditions.description: No student appears in more than one pair.
The number of pairs formed is the maximum possible.
Among the pairs formed, the number of boy-girl pairs is maximized.
